title: Donnie Brasco
about: An undercover FBI agent gets too close to the tired hitman who vouches for him.
cue: Serve the mains when Lefty first sizes Donnie up over the fake diamond.
faces: The social club down the block. Their party of five eats with us Saturdays.
Slippers at the step. No exceptions.

Private rooms for parties. Ask for the corner room.

Raw tuna and yellowtail, sliced to order. Raw? Don't even ask.

Bread for the juices.A taste of the Florida trip.How to make it500g green prawns3 tbsp olive oil4 garlic cloves, sliced1 pinch chilli flakes80ml white wine30g butter1 tbsp chopped parsley1 loaf crusty breadButterfly the prawns.Heat the olive oil until very hot, add the prawns with garlic and chilli and cook.Add the wine, bubble for a minute, then swirl in the butter and parsley.Serve in the pan with crusty bread for the juices.Mozzarella KatsuCheese fingers crumbed twice and fried golden, warm tomato sauce to dip.For the table, between conversations.How to make it400g low-moisture mozzarella50g plain flour2 eggs, beaten100g breadcrumbs500ml neutral oil, for frying250ml passata1 pinch dried oregano1 pinch saltCut the mozzarella into 16 fingers and freeze for 20 minutes.Dip in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, then egg and crumbs again.Fry in the neutral oil at 180°C for 90 seconds in batches until golden.Warm the passata with salt and oregano for dipping.MainsTeriyaki SirloinSeared hot, glazed with soy, mirin and sake. Steamed rice, bok choy.Tatami room. Shoes off, please. The boots stay on.How to make it80ml soy sauce80ml mirin60ml sake2 tbsp sugar800g sirloin steaks, 4 pieces400g short grain rice4 baby bok choysSimmer the soy, mirin, sake and sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy.Cook the rice.Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side, brushing with glaze in the last minute.Rest for 5 minutes, slice, and blanch the bok choy to serve alongside.SweetsRicotta CheesecakeBaked slow with lemon zest and vanilla, cooled in the oven.A quiet sweet finish for Lefty.How to make it750g fresh ricotta150g caster sugar4 eggs1 lemon, zested1 tsp vanilla extracticing sugar, to dustDrain the ricotta in a sieve for 2 hours.Beat with sugar, eggs, lemon zest and vanilla until smooth.Pour into a lined 22cm springform tin and bake at 160°C for 60 minutes.Turn off the oven and cool inside with the door ajar. Dust with icing sugar to serve.DrinksSocial Club Rob RoyScotch, sweet vermouth and bitters over one big cube, orange peel, a cherry.What the regulars from the club drink.How to make it200ml blended Scotch80ml sweet vermouth8 dashes of aromatic bitters4 large ice cubes1 bag ice1 orange4 cocktail cherriesPut four heavy tumblers in the freezer for 15 minutes.Stir the Scotch, vermouth and bitters with ice in a jug for 30 seconds.Strain over a large ice cube in each tumbler, twist orange peel over and drop it in, and add a cherry.
